purpose: Calibrate same-binary serial registration CPU paired-run uncertainty before interpreting small candidate effects
calibration_rule: For each CPU metric, exact paired-run median rank interval with Bonferroni m=2 must fit within +/-0.5% for preliminary ability to study ~1% changes. Report every individual pair/outlier; passing is session/workload-specific, not universal accuracy or equivalence. No candidate data collected under this A/A plan. If not met, improve design/sample evidence before classifying effects near 1%.
statistical_unit: independent router run pair, not individual request; no normality assumption; independent identically distributed paired ratios with a well-defined median are required
preflight: After existing R98 timing and heap windows: R99 physical 30-unit/protocol differential; CPU tool four unit tests and 1000-cycle C/before/reply-reuse smoke. Verify raw counters, masks, PID identity and cleanup; projected 200000-cycle time must be below 60s, leaving margin under unchanged 120s guard. Stop on any failure.
production: stock C throughout; only new disposable namespace processes are pinned; no governor/IRQ/production affinity changes
failure_rule: Stop on identity, correctness, collection, health, affinity or cleanup failure. Preserve failed window; never infer success from missing results.
